title: CandidateMatched (v1) data
description: The matching service scored a candidate against the job they applied for.

job_title.description: From the job catalogue. Optional: added after v1 shipped, so older events don't have it.

job_location.description: From the job catalogue. Optional, like job_title.

years_of_experience.description: Copied from CvParsed; null when the CV doesn't say. Optional, like job_title.

languages.description: Copied from CvParsed. Optional, like job_title.

score.description: Weighted share of the job's skills the candidate has: required skills count twice, nice-to-have skills once. 100 * (2 * required_matched + nice_matched) / (2 * required_total + nice_total), rounded.

recommendation.description: strong_match >= 75, possible_match >= 50, otherwise weak_match. Only strong matches notify the recruiter.
